# MediaPipe Selfie Segmentation (bundled, 18 Nov 2026)

Background removal in the Editor uses Google's MediaPipe Selfie Segmentation, bundled here so it works offline and
never loads code from a CDN.

- Package: `@mediapipe/selfie_segmentation` 0.1.1675465747 (npm), unchanged files: the solution's JavaScript, its
  WebAssembly runtime and the selfie segmentation models (`.tflite`).
- Copyright Google LLC. Licensed under the **Apache License, Version 2.0** (the package's licence; full text in
  `LICENSE` next to this file).
- Homepage: https://google.github.io/mediapipe/solutions/selfie_segmentation
